title: Visualization and Characterization of Bulk Oxygen Nanobubbles using Fluid Peak Force Quantitative Nano-Mechanical Atomic Force Microscopy.
content: Nanobubble (NB) technology has emerging applications in advanced aeration system for environmental and agricultural applications [1]. Nanobubbles are gas-filled entities with diameters smaller than 1 µm and exhibit unique physicochemical properties, including long-term stability in water, elevated internal pressure, and a negatively charged gas-liquid interface. Owing to these properties, NB are utilized in a range of processes involving adsorption, reactive oxygen species formation, and gas-liquid transfer [1].
